observations: Photo 0: front of a black DSLR body with a body cap fitted and no lens; 'Canon', 'EOS 5D' and 'Mark II' are printed on the front.
Photo 1: back of the body with the rear LCD switched off, eyecup fitted, MENU, INFO, AF-ON buttons, quick control dial and ON/OFF switch; no visible cracks or heavy wear.
Photo 2: underside with a label reading 'Canon DS126201', 'DC 8.1V', 'Made in Japan' and a serial number 3761814763; the battery door is open and no battery is visible.
All three photos are clean studio shots on a white background with the dealer watermark 'CDICSON BUSINESS WORLD' and 'POSTED ON JIJI'.
No photo shows the camera powered on, a shutter count, a battery, a charger or a lens.
The seller's text is only a generic product description of the 5D Mark II, with no condition statement.

identity.kind: full frame DSLR camera, body only
read_from: photo 0 front badge 'Canon EOS 5D Mark II'

claims.evidence: Photo 0 front badges and photo 2 base label DS126201 agree.

claims.claim: Full frame DSLR with 21.1 megapixel sensor
claims.evidence: This is the model's published specification; it cannot be checked from photos, but follows from the model shown.

risks.risk: Camera does not power on, shutter or sensor faulty
risks.proof: A clip of the camera switched on, taking a shot and showing the image on the rear screen

risks.risk: High shutter count near end of life
risks.proof: A screenshot of the shutter count read from a test image
A photo of the battery fitted and the charger
risks.if_unproven: as body only, no battery or charger

risks.risk: Scratched or damaged sensor or mirror under the body cap
risks.proof: A photo with the body cap off showing the mirror box, and a test shot of a plain sky at small aperture
risks.if_unproven: as needing sensor cleaning or repair

risks.risk: Dealer stock photos rather than the actual unit offered
risks.proof: A photo of the camera beside a handwritten note with today's date and the seller's name, showing the base serial

proof_requests: A clip of the camera powered on, taking a shot and reviewing it on the screen
A photo of the actual unit with a handwritten dated note and the base serial visible
A photo of the mirror box with the body cap off
Photos of the battery and charger if included
response.reason: The model is read clearly from the front badges in photo 0 and the base label in photo 2, so it can be priced as a body only at its worst case, not proven working. A working clip, shutter count and battery and charger photos would raise it.
